description: Dependency updates release nothing by themselves (build(deps), docs/releasing.md): they wait in main and go out with the next weekly release that has a feat, fix or perf. They arrive on Monday mornings, grouped, once a release has been out three days, so they are merged before Tuesday's release. Security fixes are the exception: fix(deps), at any time, straight away.
Security fixes: fix(deps), so the next release (or an urgent one by hand) ships them. Any time, no waiting, not grouped.

packageRules.description: Every dependency update is build(deps), which releases nothing (tools/release/.releaserc.json). This replaces fix(deps) from :semanticCommits for production dependencies. Security fixes stay fix(deps) (vulnerabilityAlerts).

One weekly pull request for every minor, patch and digest update. The rules below keep their own groups (JUnit, Cucumber, Spring Boot, JDK, Node) because they come later. Majors stay one pull request each.
One pull request for the shared JUnit catalog line. Stay on major 6; a major is a human decision.
One pull request for the shared Cucumber 8 catalog line. Stay on major 8. A Cucumber 9 line needs its own rule.

One pull request for the Spring Boot 4 catalog line. Stay on major 4: Spring Boot 5 is a new lsd-mono-spring-boot-5 module. When the Boot BOM moves JUnit, lsd-mono-spring-boot-4's BootJunitVersionTest fails until spring-boot-junit in the catalog is bumped in the same pull request.
Stay on kotlinx.coroutines 1. lsd-mono-coroutines is built against that major; a 2.x release is a human decision.

JDKs for CI (setup-java) and toolchains. A new major is a human decision: it changes which JDKs CI tests on (gradle.yml matrix) and must stay in step with the jvm baseline in gradle/libs.versions.toml, which Renovate does not manage.
Minor and patch JDK updates in one pull request.

Node in .nvmrc, the single source for CI (node-version-file) and the Gradle Node lookup (NodeToolchain.kt). A new major needs approval and a check that the report build still runs (engines in modules/lsd-mono-report-html/ui/package.json).
Minor and patch Node updates in one pull request.
Release notes: @semantic-release/release-notes-generator 14 renders with conventional-changelog-writer 8, which the conventionalcommits preset supports only up to major 9. Move both together.
